categories.label: Scenario goal completed
categories.labelVi: Hoàn thành mục tiêu kịch bản
categories.hint: Win only by completing the goal printed on the Scenario cards.

categories.label: Hope tokens left at end
categories.labelVi: Hope còn lại khi kết thúc
categories.hint: Lose if the last Hope token is removed.

categories.label: Discontent tokens on track at end
categories.labelVi: Discontent trên track khi kết thúc
categories.hint: Lose when a 6th Discontent token is placed.

winCondition: Cooperative: win by completing the goal of the scenario (see Scenario cards). Lose if any of: last Hope token removed; a 6th Discontent token placed; the Generator breaks down a second time; any Sickness marker on space 26+ in the Preparation Phase; Hunger level 25+ after spending Food in the Hunger Phase; the Corpse marker reaches the last space of the Corpse track.

endCondition.description: Game ends on a lose condition or when the scenario goal is completed

notes: family: coop. No points. The exact scenario goal differs per scenario (scenario book not fully modelled). Hope/Discontent counters are optional reference fields only.
